method: 1 km chainage bins; DBSCAN on one-dimensional chainage within corridor and side; descriptive local neighbourhood score
limitations: Not formal Getis-Ord Gi*: no verified spatial weights or exposure denominator.
Chainage is not latitude/longitude; map requires official route geometry and chainage calibration.
Accident counts alone are not exposure-adjusted risk; traffic volume/AADT is needed.
Candidate labels are exploratory, not verified blackspots.
